# CampusNetra

> CampusNetra is an intelligent campus facility management platform for universities, colleges and research facilities. It combines issue reporting, work order orchestration, a live digital twin of the campus, AI-driven predictive maintenance, and a shared Lost & Found in one system.

CampusNetra replaces the paper forms, WhatsApp groups and spreadsheets most campuses currently run facilities on. A student or staff member reports an issue with a photo; it's automatically classified and routed to the right department; a technician works it as a tracked work order against an SLA; the campus's live digital twin reflects the change as it happens.

## Product

- [Features](https://campusnetra.dpdns.org/features): the nine connected modules — issue reporting, work orders, digital twin, predictive maintenance, inspections, Lost & Found, analytics, SLA tracking, role-based access.
- [Pricing](https://campusnetra.dpdns.org/pricing): priced per deployment, not a flat per-seat rate.
- [Security](https://campusnetra.dpdns.org/security): specific account and data protection measures.

## Who it's for

- [Universities](https://campusnetra.dpdns.org/solutions/universities): multi-campus, multi-building deployments.
- [Colleges](https://campusnetra.dpdns.org/solutions/colleges): single-campus facility management.
- [Research facilities](https://campusnetra.dpdns.org/solutions/research): equipment- and lab-heavy environments.
- [Facility managers](https://campusnetra.dpdns.org/solutions/managers): the day-to-day dispatching/triage workflow.
